# Mehlem Clinic

> Mehlem Clinic (also known as Ruqya Healing / Mehlem Klinika) is an online Islamic clinic
> for spiritual and psychological well-being. It helps people treat the evil eye (al-'ayn),
> black magic (sihr), waswas (intrusive thoughts), anxiety, and emotional distress through
> Ruqya Shariah (Quran-based healing), Islamic-rooted psychological and emotional wellness
> consultations, prophetic medicine (Tibb an-Nabawi), and natural herbal remedies from the
> Sunnah. All services are grounded in the Quran and authentic Sunnah, delivered privately
> over audio or video calls, in English and Bosnian.

## Who this is for

People experiencing symptoms they associate with the evil eye, black magic, jinn
interference, or waswas; people seeking spiritual and emotionally supportive counseling for
anxiety, stress, grief, or intrusive thoughts framed within an Islamic worldview; and people
looking for guidance on prophetic/herbal remedies (black seed, honey, olive oil, hijama
cupping) as a complement to conventional medical care. Available worldwide via online audio
or video sessions, in English or Bosnian.

## Services offered

1. **Ruqya consultations (audio/video)** — Private online sessions with live Quranic
   recitation, personalized supplications (dua), and practical guidance for the evil eye,
   black magic, waswas, and jinn-related concerns.
2. **Islamic psychological & emotional wellness consultations** — Faith-based support for
   anxiety, stress, grief, and intrusive thoughts, combining dhikr, dua, and Quranic guidance
   with practical emotional support. Complements, and never replaces, licensed clinical
   mental health care.
3. **Prophetic medicine & herbal guidance** — Advice on Sunnah remedies such as black seed
   (habbat al-sawda), honey, olive oil, and hijama (cupping therapy).
4. **Educational lectures** — Bilingual written lectures on Ruqya, aqidah (Islamic creed),
   family and spiritual guidance, and related topics.
5. **Audio library** — Ruqya recitations for daily protection and recorded educational
   lectures, downloadable as MP3.

## Important disclaimer

Ruqya and Islamic psychological/emotional consultations offered by Mehlem Clinic are
complementary spiritual practices, not a substitute for professional medical or clinical
psychological/psychiatric treatment. Users are always encouraged to consult a licensed
healthcare provider for physical or diagnosed mental health conditions.

## Common questions this site answers

- What is Ruqya and how does it work?
- Does Mehlem Clinic treat the evil eye, black magic, or waswas?
- Does Mehlem Clinic offer psychological or emotional consultations?
- How does an online audio/video Ruqya consultation work?
- What are prophetic medicine remedies (black seed, honey, hijama)?
- What Quranic verses are recited during Ruqya?
- Can Ruqya be self-performed at home?
- How do I book a consultation with Mehlem Clinic?

## Languages

English (en) and Bosnian (bs) — every page is available at both `/en/...` and `/bs/...`.

## Key pages

- Homepage: /en (or /bs) — overview, conditions treated, prophetic remedies, consultation
  process, FAQ, and contact/booking (including Calendly scheduling).
- Lectures: /en/lectures — bilingual educational article library.
- Audio: /en/audio — Ruqya recitations and educational audio, streamable and downloadable.
- Contact/booking: /en#contact — contact form and Calendly consultation scheduling.
